svg.title: Now, next, and the engine we are building
svg.desc: Two tracks run now in parallel. Gameplay coverage remains 24 of 44 required checks. The Power Bomb pickup is checked on the older navigation source; replay on current main is pending, so no additional coverage pass is claimed. Spore Spawn is next. Collision bank retirement removes 90 engine lines, or 88 excluding formatting, with zero verification growth. Eight actual grapple component-call comparisons match exactly; the area mutation is caught and its restored control passes. These are component comparisons, not a grapple gameplay movie. The sm_94 bank still contains 734 lines and its retirement is incomplete. Next: remove duplicate code and remaining RAM callers to finish safe owned Session state. Then: our own video and audio, playing boot to credits independently of the SNES runtime. Target: a modular engine below 100,000 production lines supporting Map Rando custom sprites, reordered rooms and doors, and opt-in quality-of-life mechanics.
